scope: Read-only offline combined recovery inspection for files and selected encrypted browser copies
behavior: Uses existing decryptRecovery password, schema and cryptographic integrity validation without importing a session or initializing providers.

Shows saved network/address, report and deployment identifiers, uncertainty/preparation markers, saved draft/notes and immutable report journal inputs. Does not render secret keys or transaction lookup controls.
Explicit clear invalidates pending continuations and drops rendered data, inspection password and selected file. Local read/decryption has a three-minute deadline.
Inspection remains available alongside an active program or autosave writer; export/restore retain their own controls.

unit.scope: Real encrypted network browser copy with mocked storage, private data clearing, delayed file reads after clear/unmount/deadline, and existing RecoveryPanel regressions.

browser.correction: The broad button count included an accessible disclosure summary. Replaced it with a direct absence check for Check transaction status.
browser.scope: Desktop and mobile real encrypted v8 file inspection, wrong-password retry, private journal inputs, no wallet connect, no lookup button, no exposed vendor secret, no horizontal overflow and explicit clearing. Six recovery-input/deadline regressions passed in the first run.

release.scope: Normal web typecheck/build and release manifest after browser tests.

limits: Saved data is historical; inspection does not authenticate current ledger state, authorize retry, or reconcile pending reports.
File browser E2E uses a synthetic connector; browser-copy storage is mocked in component tests. No native wallet, physical suspend, full regression or container refresh.
Clearing removes application references/rendered data; it does not guarantee memory erasure. Navigating between screens retains inspection in the tab.
Saved private draft is displayed as a draft; it is not presented as a current ledger-backed report.
